::: {.callout-important title="This week: November 16 to 20"}

1. **Monday, Lab 225:** Open the [capacitor slides](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1QKVYTvEYKO5p1Tl6bNlBuRuYwMWiad3VUAgJcsY9Dbg/edit){target="_blank"}. Start at slide 1, play the videos when they appear, and continue through slide 19. Then complete Parts 1 to 4 of the [capacitor notebook](https://jupyter.org/try-jupyter/lab/index.html?fromURL=https%3A%2F%2Fandrewandrade.ca%2Ftech-edu-resources%2Fassets%2Ftej-computational%2Fnotebooks%2F10-capacitors-from-zero.ipynb){target="_blank"}. Submit the notebook by **Tuesday at 7:00 PM**.
2. **Tuesday, Portable 1:** Complete both pages of the [capacitor graph handout](../assets/electronics/worksheets/capacitors-tuesday-worksheet.pdf). Small groups rotate to the component table to meter-check and sort resistors and capacitors. Submit clear photos of both pages by **Wednesday at 7:00 PM**.
3. **Wednesday, Lab 225:** Open the [RC data and functions notebook](https://jupyter.org/try-jupyter/lab/index.html?fromURL=https%3A%2F%2Fandrewandrade.ca%2Ftech-edu-resources%2Fassets%2Ftej-computational%2Fnotebooks%2F11-rc-charge-discharge.ipynb){target="_blank"}. Calculate the time constant, plot Tuesday's measurements as dots, define the charging and discharging functions, draw the smooth curves, and use capacitor voltage to predict a fading LED's current.
4. **Thursday, Portable 1:** Continue sorting components and complete the Stage 1 calculation and paper wiring plan. No powered build.
5. **Friday, Lab 220:** Begin [Stage 1: LED, resistor, and pushbutton](circuits/led-capacitor-build-sequence.qmd) in Tinkercad. Submit the link and screenshot by **Sunday, November 22 at 7:00 PM**. Monday, November 23 is the lab correction day. Physical building begins only after the simulation earns 100%.

[Open the complete capacitor week page](electronics-library/components/capacitors.qmd).

[Open the component-sorting and RC station notes](circuits/hands-on-circuit-stations.qmd).

:::
